category_title: Disengaged students with off-task behaviors and social distractions
scenario_title: Informal assessments and quizzes on iPads
minimal_context: The student is taking an informal science assessment on an iPad and needs to identify a testable comparison question.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please open the science quiz on your iPads. Your first task is to read the options and identify the testable comparison question.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: I forgot what we were supposed to do. We went to the forest and looked to see, but I don't know what to put here.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Just read through the questions on your screen and try to figure it out.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Why are there bubbles in the pond? What? It doesn’t make any sense.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Keep trying. Pick the one that looks like a good comparison question.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Some of these questions were hard for me ’cuz I didn’t—like biodiversity, I didn’t know what it meant. I can't identify the right question, so I'm just leaving this incomplete.
